title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap facts, credit billing, governance statements and documented controls are supported. Both API calls flagged by the pre-check are documented, including the allocation request body and the deprecated consumption endpoint.
